A copy of the bank statement of the Samiti is on record.
It is further submitted that the applicant has deposited the remaining amount of Rs.90,000/- in the account of the Samiti.
It is submitted that the machine could not be purchased due to Covid-19 pandemic.
The applicant has not misappropriated the amount.
The amount has been duly deposited by the applicant.
It is submitted that the applicant has no criminal antecedent.
The applicant shall cooperate in the investigation/trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer made by the applicant's counsel.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and considering the nature of accusation and the undertaking given on behalf of the applicant that he shall cooperate in the investigation/trial, prima facie, it appears that the entire money has been deposited by the applicant in the account of the Samiti, I am of the opinion that in the event of arrest, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in this case in the light of judgment of Supreme Court in Sushila Aggarwal and others vs. State (NCT of Delhi) and another (2020)5 SCC 1, subject to his cooperation in the investigation/trial.

sentences.text: The applicant shall cooperate in the investigation/trial and he will not influence the witnesses.

The accused-applicant will report to the police station concerned within 20 days from today and shall remain present as and when the arresting officer /I.O./ S.H.O. concerned call (s) for investigation/interrogation.
The applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the Court.
In case of default, it would be open for the investigating agency to move application for vacation of this order.
